title: Role Management
description: Manage roles and the permissions they hold.

deletePopover.question: Are you sure you want to delete this role?

form.editInfo: Updating role details and permissions may affect related users. Make sure to review the changes before saving.

presets.label: Role Template
presets.hint: Selecting a template fills the permissions according to the permission matrix; you can still adjust them one by one.

admin.name: Administrator
admin.description: Unlimited access across the system, including role and user management.

fieldChief.name: Field Chief / Foreman
fieldChief.description: Can start and manage processes, but cannot delete them.

fieldStaff.name: Field Staff
fieldStaff.description: Sees and fills in the stages of their own work; cannot start a process.

warehouse.name: Warehouse Officer
warehouse.description: Full access to the material module; view only in the process flow.

qualityControl.name: Quality Control / Observer
qualityControl.description: View only, including past records; cannot enter data.
